module: Stategraph node "Transition". Ends the current state and moves to a new state: on flow, collects the value of all its custom input pins (except 'flow') and calls self.mgr.states:transition(stateId, transitionName, data, self). transitionName is 'success' by default and is chosen among the transitions of the state node. The data can be read in the next state with the "Get Transition Variables" node.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

makePinTemplates.desc: Builds the pin templates (name/type) from the other transition and transitionStack nodes of the project.

drawCustomProperties.desc: "Transition Name" dropdown based on the parent state node.

work.desc: If flow, triggers the transition with the pins' data (nil if there are none).

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central content of the node in the editor.

customContextMenu.desc: Adds to the context menu "Go to target..." listing the target graphs of this transition.
